Name: Aims Immersive Lance
Author: aimsvalley
Description:
[b][color=#741b47][size=5][font=Courier New]Description[/font][/size][/color][/b]
Welcome to my passion project <3 Aims Immersive Lance is a romance and dialogue expansion for Lance. This is a slow-burn mod that follows SVE's progression and leaves Lance's regular heart events intact. Some of my events require late-game areas, including the enchanted grove quest, badlands, and fable reef. I honestly recommend playing on a new save or one where you haven't started dating Lance yet for the best experience. Year 2 or significant SVE progression is recommended, but its not required.

[b][color=#cc0000]18+ Content Notice[/color][/b]
This mod is intended for players 18 and older only. There are some suggestive scenes, dialogue, some violence and mature romantic themes sprinkled throughout. Nothing explicitly graphic, but Lance is a grown man and occasionally acts like one LMAO. Please don't download this if you're under 18. Thank you. ♡

[b][color=#741b47][size=5][font=Courier New]Story spoilers and event requirements[/font][/size][/color][/b]
For anyone who wants to know what to expect, I've included some spoilers below. You can skip these if you'd rather experience everything naturally tbh
[spoiler]The storyline includes training and sparring with lance, a campfire confession to the farmer, adventures in the badlands, a soul tie storyline involving magnus heavily, romantic outings with lance, a custom proposal, and a wedding.

Some of these events have dialogue choices that affect how certain scenes will play out. The storyline also includes waiting periods between events, so not every event will happen immediately after the previous one, hence it being a slow burn. The badlands storyline requires galdora progression, and later events require additional SVE story progression.[/spoiler]
[heading][color=#741b47][font=Courier New]Installation instructions[/font][/color][/heading]
[list]
[*]Install Stardew Valley Expanded and the required mods listed below.[/*]
[*]Download Aims Immersive Lance and extract the folder into your mods folder[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional but recommended if you'd like to change the available configuration settings in-game. :)[/*]
[/list][heading][color=#741b47][font=Courier New]Main features[/font][/color][/heading]
[list]
[*]19 custom storyline events and a custom wedding.[/*]
[*]expanded dating and marriage dialogue.[/*]
[*]dialogue choices throughout the relationship.[/*]
[*]a custom proposal and wedding.[/*]
[*]new letters, seasonal gifts, and occasional phone calls.[/*]
[*]new dialogue and reactions from characters connected to lance, including magnus, marlon, camilla, and others.[/*]
[*]additional rescue/pass out interactions.[/*]
[*]more marriage content, including anniversaries, special outings, and seasonal conversations.[/*]
[*]configurable pet names, spouse titles, and pronouns.[/*]
[/list][b][color=#741b47][font=Courier New]Additional content[/font][/color][/b]
[spoiler]Marriage includes anniversary letters and events, special conversations, seasonal dialogue choices, additional bathhouse content (it is a bit suggestive), as well as a suggestive highlands outpost event as well, and a married fable reef outing.
There are also changes to certain rescue situations, additional character reactions, and special dialogue tied to your relationship.[/spoiler]
[heading][color=#741b47]Requirements[/color][/heading]
[b]Required mods:[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded[/*]
[*]ScriptCommandPlus[/*]
[*]Custom Tokens[/*]
[/list][b]Optional:[/b]
[list]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu[/*]
[/list][heading][color=#741b47]Shout outs[/color][/heading]
Thank you to FlashShifter for creating Stardew Valley Expanded and Lance. Without SVE, this mod wouldn't exist! I also want to thank my testers who managed to find things that were terribly wrong that I somehow completely missed LMAO. Thank you my sweet angels for taking the time to play through everything, report bugs, and help me get things working properly. I really appreciate you guys! I also want to thank my friends who spent hours helping me proofread, discussing scenes with me, and making sure the dialogue stayed true to lance's character. I really appreciate the time you all put into helping me with this project. And thank you to the stardew valley modding community for the guides, documentation, and resources that helped me learn.

[b][color=#ff00ff][font=Impact]A little note from me:[/font][/color][/b]
so this is my very first published mod...i originally started making this for myself because i wanted more lance content in my own game, and it somehow turned into this whole project lol. i've genuinely had so much fun writing and playing through everything, and i figured maybe someone else would enjoy it too, even if its just one person.
i've spent a lot of time learning, writing, and testing, but with the amount of content included, i assume there will be things i've missed. i'm also a little terrified to finally publish this lol, so please be nice to me.
if you do run into any issues, please include your SMAPI log, your relationship status with lance, and the last event you completed when reporting a bug. i'll do my very best to look into problems when i'm able to, but i can't guarantee immediate fixes or compatibility with every mod combination.
constructive feedback is always welcome, and i just ask that everyone be respectful. thank you for giving my first mod a try! ♡
